title: Should not allow user update 'Health' with invalid value

comments_data.body:
> @lebaphi I can input the number < 0 and > 100 . I think we should not. @IanMayo How do you think?
> 
Nice observation @Tristina1788 , but we don't actually specify limits for number-properties - I just included it in the description as a hint. We _may_ extend to include that in the future, but it's not a current requirement.

Here is what we specify:

issues.title: 5.1.7 - Submit orders (mock)
issues.body:
As a < **player** >, I want to < **submit my orders** > so that < **my forces move towards my tactical objectives** >.

# Acceptance criteria

Setup: load game, play as red/blue, produce some planned routes for my platforms

- [ ] When I press submit, the 'Orders' message is sent

# UX
_Maybe_ it's just a Send button

# Notes
Ian to produce example of message format.

# Infrastructure
In this phase this will be implemented by providing a drop-down list that contains a set of JSON messages that were predefined in our source code.

comments.body: We can drop this, we're close to real orders being sent around
